name: number_partitioning_k5_n25_seed78098__v5_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 25} into 5 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 65. (The total sum is 25*(25+1)/2 = 325, so the target is 325/5 = 65.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 25 integers in {0, ..., 4} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
